info.name: NVS Rice Mart — Vendor Platform API
info.description:
# NVS Rice Mart — Vendor Platform API

Single-shop se **vendor-based multi-tenant** platform me shift ke baad ki poori API.
Teen folder hain, teeno **call sequence me** lage hue hain:

| Folder | Kiske liye | Sequence |
|---|---|---|
| **Customer** | Mobile app dev | login → address → catalog → cart → verify → preview → order → tracking → cancel |
| **Vendor** | Vendor panel dev | login → profile/delivery → catalog CRUD → order queue → status transitions |
| **Admin** | Admin panel dev | login → vendor create → branch → pincode lookup → service area → monitoring |

---

## Shuru kaise karein

1. Environment **"NVS Rice Mart"** select karo (upar right corner).
2. Env me `target` set karo — `local`, `stage` ya `prod`. Har request se pehle `baseUrl` apne aap us hisaab se set ho jata hai.
3. Apne folder ka **pehla login request** chalao — token apne aap `{{customerToken}}` / `{{vendorToken}}` / `{{adminToken}}` me save ho jata hai. Aage har request usi ko use karti hai, manually paste karne ki zaroorat nahi.
4. Baaki requests **upar se neeche** chalate jao — har request apne baad wali ke liye id (`{{categoryId}}`, `{{productId}}`, `{{orderId}}`…) env me save karti jaati hai.

## Stage ke test accounts

| Role | Login | Password | Kya expect karein |
|---|---|---|---|
| admin | `ricemartnvs@gmail.com` | `Admin@123` | platform summary, 1 vendor |
| vendor | `nagraj@gmail.com` | `nagraj@123` | apna order queue + 30 products |
| customer (in-area) | `9886061450` | `Stage@123` | pincode 577001 → catalog `200` |
| customer (out-of-area) | `9620508145` | `Stage@123` | pincode 500774 → `404 PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` |
| customer (no address) | `8660222341` | `Stage@123` | koi address nahi → `400 PINCODE_REQUIRED` |

---

## Response ka shape

Har response ek hi envelope me aata hai:

```jsonc
// success
{ "success": true,  "message": "…", "data": { … } }

// error
{ "success": false, "message": "…", "error": { … }, "code": "PINCODE_REQUIRED" }
```

**Client hamesha `code` pe branch kare, `message` pe nahi** — `message` badal sakta hai, `code` fixed hai.

## Poore platform ke error codes

| HTTP | `code` | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `PINCODE_REQUIRED` | Customer ka default address nahi, query me bhi pincode nahi |
| 404 | `PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Is pincode pe koi vendor nahi |
| 409 | `PINCODE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED` | Pincode pehle se doosre vendor ka hai |
| 404 | `PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE_HERE` | Product doosre vendor ka hai |
| 409 | `CART_VENDOR_CONFLICT` | Cart me doosre vendor ka item |
| 409 | `VENDOR_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Cart ka vendor is address pe deliver nahi karta |
| 503 | `VENDOR_PICKUP_MISSING` | Vendor ka default branch missing (data issue) |
| 409 | `STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` | Order ke waqt stock kam nikla |
| 400 | `OUT_OF_RADIUS` | Address vendor ke `maxRadiusKm` se bahar |
| 400 | `MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET` | Subtotal `minOrderAmount` se kam |
| 409 | `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | Is role ko ye status change allowed nahi |
| 409 | `CART_NOT_VERIFIED` | Order se pehle `verify-delivery` nahi chalayi |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Ye resource aapka nahi |

## Saare enums ek jagah

| Enum | Values |
|---|---|
| `role` | `user` · `vendor` · `admin` · `staff` |
| `ORDER_STATUS` | `PENDING` · `ACCEPTED` · `PACKED` · `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` · `DELIVERED` · `CANCELLED` · `REJECTED` · `CONFIRMED`(legacy) · `INITIATED`(internal) |
| `PAYMENT_METHODS` | `COD` (`ONLINE` abhi disabled) |
| `PAYMENT_STATUS` | `NOT_REQUIRED` · `INITIATED` · `SUCCESS` · `FAILED` |
| `VENDOR_STATUS` | `APPROVED` · `SUSPENDED` |
| `LOCATION_TYPES` | `CUSTOMER` · `VENDOR_BRANCH` |
| `PRODUCT_TYPES` | `grocery` · `electronics` · `clothing` |
| `LOGIN_TYPES` | `email` · `mobile` · `google` · `password` · `other` |
| `SUBSCRIPTION_TYPES` | `weekly` · `monthly` · `quarterly` · `half_yearly` · `yearly` |

## Order status machine

| Abhi | Vendor | Customer | Admin |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PENDING` | `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED` | `CANCELLED` | — |
| `ACCEPTED` | `PACKED`, `REJECTED` | `CANCELLED` | — |
| `PACKED` | `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` | — | — |
| `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` | `DELIVERED` | — | — |
| `DELIVERED` / `CANCELLED` / `REJECTED` | — | — | — |

**Admin ka column jaan-boojh ke khaali hai** — admin sirf dekh sakta hai, order aage nahi badha sakta.

---

## Hataye gaye endpoints (ab 404 "Invalid API" denge)

| Endpoint | Kyun |
|---|---|
| `POST /orders/verify-payment` | Razorpay disabled, COD only |
| `PUT /orders/update/:id` | Admin ab status nahi badal sakta — vendor ka `PUT /orders/:id/status` use karo |
| `PUT /products/update-product-locations/:productId` | `ProductLocation` model hi delete ho gaya |
| `DELETE /products/remove-product-locations/:productId` | wahi |
| `POST /products/check-delivery/:productId` | `GET /service-areas/check?zipcode=` use karo |

## Saved examples ke baare me

Har request ka **200/201 example save hai** aur wo **StageDB pe asli call maar ke** record kiya gaya hai —
haath se nahi likha. Sirf 4 OTP endpoints ke examples documented hain (unhe chalane pe asli SMS/email
chala jata hai), aur un requests ki description me wo saaf likha hai.

item.name: 1 · Customer (mobile app)
item.description:
**Mobile app ka poora flow — login se delivery tak, isi order me.**

Sabse pehle `01 Auth → 06 Login with password` chalao; token `{{customerToken}}` me save ho jayega.

Sabse zyada dhyan in teen pe do — inke bina app tutegi:
- **`400 PINCODE_REQUIRED`** → address add karne ki screen dikhao (stage pe ~93% customers ke paas address hai hi nahi)
- **`404 PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE`** → "abhi yahan available nahi" screen
- **`409 CART_VENDOR_CONFLICT`** → "cart clear karke naya item add karein?" dialog, phir `?replaceCart=true`

Aur order se pehle ye sequence tod mat dena: **verify-delivery → preview → create**.

request.description:
Naya customer account banata hai aur seedha JWT token wapas deta hai (OTP ki zaroorat nahi).

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** Public

**Sequence me kab:**
- App pe 'Sign up' screen — OTP flow ka alternative.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Breaking:** `role` ab body se accept **nahi** hota. Pehle koi bhi `"role": "admin"` bhej ke admin account bana leta tha — ye security hole band kar diya gaya hai. Ye endpoint hamesha `role: "user"` banata hai.
- Vendor account admin banata hai (`POST /vendors/create`), admin account seedha DB me — dono yahan se nahi bante.
- `email` ya `mobile` — koi ek zaroori hai.
- Ek hi mobile alag-alag role me ho sakta hai (unique index `{mobile, role}` pe hai), isliye same number vendor aur customer dono ka ho sakta hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | no | `Ramesh Kulkarni` |
| email | string | email ya mobile | `ramesh.kulkarni@gmail.com` |
| mobile | string | email ya mobile | `9886061450` — 10 digit |
| password | string | yes | `Ramesh@123` |
| loginType | enum | no | default `password` |
| fcmToken | string | no | Push notification ke liye device token |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| loginType | `email` · `mobile` · `google` · `password` · `other` | Sirf record ke liye — auth logic isse nahi badalti |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | — | Is email/mobile ka user already hai |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |

request.description:
OTP verify karke JWT token deta hai. Yahi se app login hota hai.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** Public

**Sequence me kab:**
- Step 02 ke turant baad.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Breaking:** `role` ab ignore hota hai — token hamesha `user` ka milta hai. Vendor/admin ko `POST /auth/login` use karna padega.
- `sessionId` step 02 ke response ke `data.otpData.Details` se aata hai.
- Success pe `data.token` milta hai — ise app securely store kare aur har request me `Authorization: Bearer <token>` bheje.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| mobile | string | yes | `9886061450` |
| otp | string | yes | `123456` — SMS wala 6 digit |
| sessionId | string | yes | step 02 ka `otpData.Details` |
| loginType | enum | no | default `mobile` |
| currentScreen | string | no | `HOME` — analytics ke liye |
| fcmToken | string | no | Device push token |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | — | Invalid OTP |
| 404 | — | Is mobile ka customer nahi mila |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |

---

> ⚠️ **Iska saved example documented hai, live capture nahi.** Ye endpoint chalane pe asli SMS/email chala jata hai aur OTP verify nahi ho sakta, isliye example controller ke asli response shape se banaya gaya hai (user object asli login response ka hai). Baaki sab endpoints ke examples StageDB pe asli call maar ke record kiye gaye hain.

item.name: 06 · ⭐ Login with password (testing ke liye yahi use karo)

request.description:
Password se login. **Stage testing ke liye sabse aasan** — SMS/email ka wait nahi karna padta.

✅ **unchanged** — pehle jaisa hi hai

**Auth:** Public

**Sequence me kab:**
- Sabse pehla call. Token `{{customerToken}}` me apne aap save ho jata hai.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- `type` batata hai lookup email se karna hai ya mobile se: `"type": "email"` → `email` field bhejo, `"type": "mobile"` → `mobile` field bhejo.
- `role` yahan sirf **lookup** ke liye hai (unique index `{mobile, role}` pe hai). Naya account yahan se banta hi nahi aur password verify hota hai — isliye ye safe hai.
- **Stage credentials** — `9886061450` / `Stage@123` (pincode 577001, catalog dikhega), `9620508145` / `Stage@123` (bahar ka pincode → 404), `8660222341` / `Stage@123` (koi address nahi → 400).

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| type | enum | yes | `mobile` ya `email` |
| mobile | string | type=mobile pe | `9886061450` |
| email | string | type=email pe | `ramesh.kulkarni@gmail.com` |
| password | string | yes | `Stage@123` |
| role | enum | no | default `user` |
| loginType | enum | no | default `password` |
| fcmToken | string | no | Device push token |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| type | `mobile` · `email` | Kis field se user dhoondna hai |
| role | `user` · `vendor` · `admin` · `staff` | Customer ke liye `user` |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | — | Wrong password |
| 404 | — | Is mobile/email + role ka user nahi mila |
| 422 | — | `type` ke hisaab se required field missing |

request.description:
Apna naam / DOB / email / mobile / profile photo update karo.

✅ **unchanged** — pehle jaisa hi hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Profile screen se.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **`multipart/form-data`** hai (JSON nahi) kyunki isme photo upload hota hai. Photo na bhejni ho to `image` field disable kar do — baaki fields text hi rehte hain.
- Saare fields optional hain — jo bhejoge wahi update hoga.
- `image` Cloudinary pe upload hoti hai, isliye stage pe test karte waqt bhi asli account me file jaayegi.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | no | `Ramesh Kulkarni` (2–100) |
| dob | date | no | `1992-08-14` |
| email | string | no | `ramesh.kulkarni@gmail.com` |
| mobile | number | no | `9886061450` — exactly 10 digit |
| image | file | no | jpg/png |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Customer ka delivery address save karta hai.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Step 09 (serviceable check) ke baad.
- Pehla address save hote hi **poora catalog unlock** ho jata hai.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Sabse pehla address apne aap `isDefault: true` ban jata hai.** Default address hi decide karta hai ki customer ko kaunse vendor ka catalog dikhega.
- **Removed fields:** `isProductAddress` aur `isVendorAddress` ab schema me hain hi nahi — bhejoge to ignore ho jayenge. Vendor branch ab `type: "VENDOR_BRANCH"` se pehchana jata hai aur sirf admin bana sakta hai.
- `coordinates` **`[latitude, longitude]`** order me hai. Ye delivery distance nikalne ke liye use hote hain — galat order me bhejoge to charge galat aayega.
- 🆕 **`district` ab OPTIONAL hai.** Required sirf paanch: `address`, `city`, `state`, `zipcode`, `coordinates`.
- 🆕 **Ab is route pe asli validation lagti hai** (pehle koi nahi thi). Jo fields server ko nahi pata wo chup-chaap drop ho jate hain — `422` nahi milega, purane clients nahi tootenge.
- 🔤 **Response me text ab proper case me aata hai** — `"davangere"` nahi, `"Davangere"`. Bhejo kuch bhi, server theek kar deta hai.
- 👉 **Sirf "mera address save karo" karna hai to `PUT /locations/upsert` use karo** — wo duplicate nahi banata. Ye route tab hai jab customer ko **kai** address rakhne dene hon (ghar + office).
- `userId` body me mat bhejo — token se apne aap lagta hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| address | string | **yes** | `12-B, Shivam Residency, Vidyanagar Main Road` |
| city | string | **yes** | `Davangere` |
| state | string | **yes** | `Karnataka` |
| zipcode | string|number | **yes** | `577001` |
| coordinates | number[2] | **yes** | `[14.4644, 75.9218]` = **[latitude, longitude]** |
| district | string | no | `Davangere` — 🆕 ab optional |
| name | string | no | `Ghar` / `Office` — address ka label |
| shopOrBuildingNumber | string | no | `12-B` |
| area | string | no | `Vidyanagar` |
| country | string | no | `India` (default) |
| formattedAddress | string | no | na bhejo to server khud banata hai |
| isDefault | boolean | no | `true` bhejo to ye default address ban jayega |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:

- `isDefault` accept **nahi** hota — upsert hamesha default address pe kaam karta hai.
- Admin `userId` bhej ke **kisi bhi** customer ka address save/update kar sakta hai. Customer kisi aur ka `userId` bheje to `403`.

### Errors

request.description:
Customer ke pincode wale vendor ki categories. **Home screen ka pehla data call.**

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Login + address set hone ke baad — home screen.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Sabse bada change:** response ab **vendor-scoped** hai. Pehle poore platform ki saari categories aati thi; ab sirf us vendor ki jo customer ke pincode pe deliver karta hai.
- Vendor kaise decide hota hai — priority order: `?locationId=` > `?zipcode=` > customer ka **default address**. Tino na ho to `400 PINCODE_REQUIRED`.
- App ko ye teen states handle karni **hi** hongi: `200` (catalog), `400 PINCODE_REQUIRED` (address add screen), `404 PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` (coming soon screen).
- `?userId=` / `?vendorId=` client se bhejne ka koi fayda nahi — server scope **last me** apply karta hai, isliye client se override nahi ho sakta.

### Query params
| Param | Matlab |
|---|---|
| zipcode | `577001` — default address override karne ke liye |
| locationId | Saved address ka id — sabse zyada priority |
| page / limit / search / sortBy / sortOrder | Standard paging |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `PINCODE_REQUIRED` | Customer ka koi default address nahi aur query me bhi pincode nahi. App ko address-add screen kholni chahiye. |
| 404 | `PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Is pincode pe koi vendor assign nahi hai. App ko "abhi yahan available nahi" screen dikhani chahiye. |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

| subCategoryId / categoryId | Catalog drill-down |

| brand / SKU / name / search | Text filters |
| type | `grocery` · `electronics` · `clothing` |
| zipcode / locationId | Service context |

| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| type | `grocery` · `electronics` · `clothing` | Product ka type |
| sortBy | `generalPrice` · `createdAt` · `stockQuantity` · `weightInKg` | Isse bahar kuch bheja to 422 |

request.description:
Cart me product daalta hai ya uski quantity set karta hai.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- PDP / listing pe '+ Add' ya quantity stepper dabane pe.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- `quantity` **set** hoti hai, add nahi — `quantity: 3` bhejoge to cart me 3 ho jayengi (4 nahi). `quantity: 0` bhejna item hatane ke barabar hai.
- **🆕 Ek cart = ek vendor.** Cart me pehle se kisi doosre vendor ka item hai to `409 CART_VENDOR_CONFLICT` milega. Response me purane vendor ka naam aata hai — app dialog dikhaye: *"Aapke cart me Nagraj Mart ke items hain. Clear karke naya item add karein?"*. User 'haan' bole to wahi request `?replaceCart=true` ke saath dobara bhejo.
- Stock se zyada quantity maangi to `409 STOCK_UNAVAILABLE`.
- **Removed:** `Cart.items[].vendorId` field hata di gayi — vendor ab cart level pe ek hi hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| productId | ObjectId | yes | `{{productId}}` |
| quantity | number | yes | `2` — 0 se 100 tak. Final quantity, increment nahi |

### Query params
| Param | Matlab |
|---|---|
| replaceCart | `true` → purana cart clear karke ye item daal do |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `CART_VENDOR_CONFLICT` | Cart me already doosre vendor ka item pada hai. `?replaceCart=true` bhejo to purana cart clear karke naya item add ho jayega. |
| 409 | `STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` | Order place karte waqt kisi item ka stock kam nikla. Response me kaunsa item hai wo aata hai. |
| 404 | `PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE_HERE` | Product exist karta hai par customer ke pincode wale vendor ka nahi hai. |
| 400 | `PINCODE_REQUIRED` | Customer ka koi default address nahi aur query me bhi pincode nahi. App ko address-add screen kholni chahiye. |
| 404 | `PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Is pincode pe koi vendor assign nahi hai. App ko "abhi yahan available nahi" screen dikhani chahiye. |

request.description:
Order banaye **bina** batata hai: subtotal, distance, delivery charge aur final payable amount.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Step 25 (verify) ke baad, step 28 (create) se **pehle**.
- Checkout screen kholte hi, aur address badalne pe dobara.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi — app ko delivery charge ka pata hi place-order ke baad chalta tha.**
- `POST /orders/create` bilkul yahi calculation use karta hai (shared helper), isliye preview aur final bill me **kabhi mismatch nahi** hoga.
- Delivery charge sirf tab lagta hai jab vendor ne apni setting me `isEnabled: true` kiya ho. Warna `deliveryCharge: 0` aata hai — aur ye by-default off hai.
- Charge ka formula: `baseCharge + (distanceKm × perKmRate) + (weightKg × perKgRate)`, phir vendor ke caps, phir platform ka hard cap **₹200**.
- `freeDeliveryAbove` cross kar gaya to charge 0 ho jata hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| locationId | ObjectId | yes | Delivery address ka id |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `CART_NOT_VERIFIED` | Order se pehle `POST /carts/verify-delivery` call karna zaroori hai. |
| 409 | `VENDOR_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Cart ka vendor is delivery address pe deliver nahi karta. |
| 400 | `OUT_OF_RADIUS` | Delivery address vendor ke `maxRadiusKm` se bahar hai. |
| 400 | `MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET` | Subtotal vendor ke `minOrderAmount` se kam hai. |
| 503 | `VENDOR_PICKUP_MISSING` | Vendor ka default branch missing hai — data issue. Admin ko `PUT /vendors/:id/branches/:locationId/default` chalana hoga. |
| 400 | — | Cart khaali hai |

request.description:
Cart ko order me convert karta hai, stock kam karta hai aur cart khaali kar deta hai.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Step 27 ke baad — 'Place Order' button.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Breaking:** `paymentMethod` me sirf `"COD"` chalega. `"ONLINE"` bhejne pe `422` — Razorpay abhi disabled hai aur `POST /orders/verify-payment` route **hata diya gaya** hai.
- Order `PENDING` status me banta hai. Aage vendor hi badhata hai.
- `orderNumber` format: `NVS-2609-000004` (`NVS-<pincode ke last 4>-<6 digit serial>`). Ye atomic counter se banta hai — duplicate kabhi nahi hoga.
- Poora operation ek **MongoDB transaction** me hota hai: stock kam, cart purchase-mark, order create — ya sab hoga ya kuch nahi.
- Har item me `productSnapshot { name, brand, SKU, image, weightInKg }` save hota hai, taaki product baad me badal jaye to bhi purana order waisa hi dikhe. **Order history me ye snapshot dikhao, live product data nahi.**
- **Removed:** `items[].vendorId`, `items[].locationId` aur `expectedDeliveryAt` fields hata di gayi hain.
- **Response ka shape dhyan se:** ye poora order document nahi deta — ek chhota confirmation object deta hai: `{ type, orderId, orderNumber, subTotal, deliveryCharge, payableAmount, status, message }`. Order ki full detail ke liye `GET /orders/get/{orderId}` call karo. **Id `data.orderId` me hai, `data._id` me nahi.**

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| locationId | ObjectId | yes | Delivery address ka id |
| paymentMethod | enum | yes | Sirf `COD` |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| paymentMethod | `COD` | `ONLINE` abhi band hai — bhejoge to 422 |
| status (response) | `PENDING` | Naya order hamesha PENDING me banta hai |
| paymentStatus (response) | `NOT_REQUIRED` | COD me payment collect delivery pe hoti hai |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `CART_NOT_VERIFIED` | Order se pehle `POST /carts/verify-delivery` call karna zaroori hai. |
| 409 | `STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` | Order place karte waqt kisi item ka stock kam nikla. Response me kaunsa item hai wo aata hai. |
| 409 | `VENDOR_NOT_SERVICEABLE` | Cart ka vendor is delivery address pe deliver nahi karta. |
| 400 | `OUT_OF_RADIUS` | Delivery address vendor ke `maxRadiusKm` se bahar hai. |
| 400 | `MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET` | Subtotal vendor ke `minOrderAmount` se kam hai. |
| 503 | `VENDOR_PICKUP_MISSING` | Vendor ka default branch missing hai — data issue. Admin ko `PUT /vendors/:id/branches/:locationId/default` chalana hoga. |
| 422 | — | `paymentMethod` COD nahi hai |

request.description:
Ek order ki poori detail — items, pricing, address, status history.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Order history se kisi order pe tap karne pe — tracking screen.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- Doosre customer ka order id daaloge to `404` — leak nahi hota.
- `statusHistory[]` me har transition ka `status`, `at`, `by`, `note` hota hai — isse tracking timeline banao.
- `deliveredAt` DELIVERED hone pe set hota hai.
- `assignedTo` / `assignedAt` fields reserve hain (delivery-boy feature future ke liye) — abhi hamesha `null` rahenge, inpe koi logic mat banao.

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Customer khud apna order cancel karta hai. Stock apne aap wapas chala jata hai.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{customerToken}}` — role `user`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Order tracking screen ka 'Cancel Order' button.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Sirf `PENDING` aur `ACCEPTED` pe chalta hai.** `PACKED` ke baad cancel nahi hota — `409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION`. App ko cancel button `PACKED` se aage chhupa dena chahiye.
- Cancel hote hi har item ka stock guarded `$inc` se wapas add ho jata hai.
- Vendor ko push notification chali jati hai.
- `reason` optional hai par UI me maangna behtar hai — vendor ko dikhta hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| reason | string | no | `Galti se order ho gaya tha` — max 300 chars |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | Is role ko current status se us status pe jaane ki permission nahi. Allowed transitions neeche table me hain. |
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Ye resource aapka nahi hai. |

**Customer ke allowed transitions:**

| Abhi status | Customer ye kar sakta hai |
|---|---|
| `PENDING` | → `CANCELLED` |
| `ACCEPTED` | → `CANCELLED` |
| `PACKED` / `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` / `DELIVERED` | ❌ kuch nahi |

item.name: 03 · 🆕 ⭐ Delivery settings update (vendor ka ekmatra edit right)

request.description:
Vendor apni delivery charge ki setting khud badalta hai. **Panel me vendor sirf yahi edit kar sakta hai.**

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Settings → Delivery screen se, jab bhi vendor rate badle.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Baaki sab admin ke haath me hai** — shop name, mobile, address, branches, pincode. Vendor sirf delivery config badal sakta hai. Panel me baaki fields read-only rakho.
- Kam se kam **1 field** bhejna zaroori hai (`{}` bhejoge to `422`).
- **`isEnabled` master switch hai.** `false` (default) = delivery charge hamesha **₹0**, chahe baaki values kuch bhi ho. Panel me sabse upar ek toggle rakho.
- Cap fields (`baseMaxCharge`, `maxPerKgIncrement`, `maxPerKmIncrement`, `freeDeliveryAbove`, `maxRadiusKm`) me **`null` ka matlab 'koi limit nahi'** hai, `0` ka matlab 'limit 0' — yaani charge hamesha 0. UI me 'No limit' checkbox se `null` bhejo, khaali input ko `0` mat bhejna.
- Platform hard caps: delivery charge max **₹200**, radius max **50 km**. Isse upar bhejoge to server chup-chaap cap laga dega.
- Naya vendor by-default: `isEnabled: false` par baaki values bhari hui (`baseCharge 30`, `perKmRate 5`, `perKgRate 1.5`, `minDeliveryCharge 40`) — taaki toggle on karte hi sensible charge lage.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| isEnabled | boolean | no | **Master switch.** `false` = delivery charge hamesha ₹0. Default `false` |
| baseCharge | number | no | `30` — har order pe fixed |
| perKmRate | number | no | `5` — per km |
| perKgRate | number | no | `1.5` — per kg |
| minDeliveryCharge | number | no | `40` — calculation isse kam aaya to ye lagega |
| baseMaxCharge | number \| null | no | `150` — total charge ki cap. `null` = koi cap nahi |
| maxPerKgIncrement | number \| null | no | `1.2` — weight component ki cap |
| maxPerKmIncrement | number \| null | no | `4` — distance component ki cap |
| freeDeliveryAbove | number \| null | no | `499` → itne ke upar delivery free. `null` = free delivery nahi |
| minOrderAmount | number | no | `0` — isse kam ka order place hi nahi hoga |
| maxRadiusKm | number \| null | no | `12` — isse door deliver nahi. `null` = koi limit nahi |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| isEnabled | `true` · `false` | `false` = charge ₹0 (default) |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | — | Ek bhi field nahi bheji, ya koi value negative hai |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

### Delivery charge kaise banta hai

```
isEnabled false      →  charge = 0        (bas, aage kuch nahi)
isEnabled true       →
   distancePart = min(distanceKm × perKmRate, maxPerKmIncrement × distanceKm)
   weightPart   = min(totalKg   × perKgRate, maxPerKgIncrement × totalKg)
   charge       = baseCharge + distancePart + weightPart
   charge       = max(charge, minDeliveryCharge)
   charge       = min(charge, baseMaxCharge)          // null ho to skip
   subTotal >= freeDeliveryAbove  →  charge = 0       // null ho to skip
   charge       = min(charge, 200)                    // platform hard cap
```

Koi hidden code-constant fallback **nahi** hai — jo vendor ne set kiya wahi lagta hai.

⚠️ **BREAKING** — purana client tut jayega, code badalna padega

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Catalog → Edit category.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **⚠️ BREAKING — `isActive` ka behaviour badal gaya hai.** Pehle `isActive` bhejne pa server current value ko **ulta** kar deta tha (toggle). Yaani `isActive: true` bhejne pe active category **inactive** ho jati thi. Ab jo bhejoge **wahi set** hota hai.
- Panel me switch ki nayi value bhejo (`true` = active karo, `false` = deactivate karo) — purana 'bas field bhej do' wala code hata do.
- `isActive` na bhejo to value waisi hi rehti hai.
- `multipart/form-data` hai (image ke liye). Sirf text badalna ho to bhi form-data hi bhejo, `image` field disable kar do.

| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | no | `Rice & Grains` |
| description | string | no | max 300 chars |
| isActive | boolean | no | `true`/`false` — **set**, toggle nahi |
| image | file | no | Nayi image |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Naya product banata hai — price aur stock isi document pe.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Category + subcategory ban jaane ke baad.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Sabse bada change:** pehle price aur stock alag `ProductLocation` collection me location-wise rehte the. Wo model **delete ho chuka hai** — ab `generalPrice` aur `stockQuantity` seedha product pe hain. Ye single source of truth hai.
- **Removed endpoints:** `PUT /products/update-product-locations/:productId` aur `DELETE /products/remove-product-locations/:productId` ab hain hi nahi.
- `weightInKg` sirf label nahi hai — delivery charge ke `perKgRate` calculation me seedha lagta hai. Sahi bharo.
- `userId` body me mat bhejo — token se lagta hai.
- `multipart/form-data`; image optional.
- Order place hote hi is product ka `name`, `brand`, `SKU`, `image`, `weightInKg` order ke `productSnapshot` me copy ho jate hain — baad me product badalne se purane order nahi badalte.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | yes | `India Gate Classic Basmati Rice 5kg` |
| brand | string | yes | `India Gate` — 3 se 80 chars |
| subCategoryId | ObjectId | yes | `{{subCategoryId}}` |
| generalPrice | number | yes | `749` — bechne wali price |
| stockQuantity | number | yes | `40` |
| weightInKg | number | yes | `5` |
| description | string | no | max 500 chars |
| type | enum | no | `grocery` (default) |
| isActive | boolean | no | default `true` |
| image | file | no | jpg/png |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| type | `grocery` · `electronics` · `clothing` | Product ka type |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Product ki price, stock ya detail badalta hai.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Roz ka kaam — stock aur rate update.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- Price/stock ab yahi se badalte hain — purane `update-product-locations` endpoints hata diye gaye hain.
- `isOutOfStock: true` se stock hote hue bhi product ko manually out-of-stock dikha sakte ho.
- Saare fields optional — jo bhejoge wahi badlega.
- `multipart/form-data`.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name / brand / description | string | no | Text fields |
| generalPrice | number | no | `799` |
| stockQuantity | number | no | `25` |
| weightInKg | number | no | `5` |
| subCategoryId | ObjectId | no | Doosri subcategory me move |
| type | enum | no | `grocery` · `electronics` · `clothing` |
| isActive | boolean | no | **set**, toggle nahi |
| isOutOfStock | boolean | no | Manual flag |
| image | file | no | Nayi photo |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Vendor ke apne orders — panel ki main screen.

🔶 **CHANGED** — request ya response badla hai

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Orders screen, har status tab ke liye.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- Vendor ko hamesha sirf apne orders milte hain — doosre vendor ka order kabhi nahi.
- `?status=PENDING` se 'naye orders' tab banao — yahi vendor ka action queue hai.
- Har item me `productSnapshot` hai — order ke waqt ka naam/photo. Panel me packing list wahi se banao.
- `deliveryAddress` embedded hai — delivery boy ko dene ke liye.

| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| status | `PENDING` · `ACCEPTED` · `PACKED` · `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` · `DELIVERED` · `CANCELLED` · `REJECTED` | Filter ke liye |

| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

request.description:
Order ko aage badhata hai. Ye ek hi endpoint saare transitions ke liye hai — sirf `status` badalta hai.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{vendorToken}}` — role `vendor`

**Sequence me kab:**
- `PENDING` order pe 'Accept' dabane pe.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi.** Purana `PUT /orders/update/:id` (admin-only) **hata diya gaya**.
- Server state machine enforce karta hai — galat transition pe `409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION`. Panel me sirf allowed buttons hi dikhao (neeche table).
- `REJECTED` pe stock apne aap wapas chala jata hai.
- Har transition pe customer ko push notification jaati hai aur `statusHistory[]` me entry add hoti hai.
- `note` optional hai — vendor ka internal note. `reason` `REJECTED` ke liye use karo.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| status | enum | yes | `ACCEPTED` — target status |
| note | string | no | max 300 chars |
| reason | string | no | max 300 chars — `REJECTED` pe zaroori jaisa |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| status | `ACCEPTED` · `PACKED` · `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` · `DELIVERED` · `REJECTED` | Vendor ke allowed targets |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | Is role ko current status se us status pe jaane ki permission nahi. Allowed transitions neeche table me hain. |
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Ye resource aapka nahi hai. |

### Allowed transitions (server enforce karta hai)

| Abhi | Vendor | Customer | Admin |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PENDING` | `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED` | `CANCELLED` | — |
| `ACCEPTED` | `PACKED`, `REJECTED` | `CANCELLED` | — |
| `PACKED` | `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` | — | — |
| `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` | `DELIVERED` | — | — |
| `DELIVERED` | — | — | — |
| `CANCELLED` / `REJECTED` | — | — | — |
| `CONFIRMED` *(legacy)* | `PACKED`, `REJECTED` | `CANCELLED` | — |

**Admin ka column poora khaali hai** — admin sirf dekh sakta hai, order aage nahi badha sakta.
Isliye vendor kuch na kare to order `PENDING` me hi pada rahega; admin vendor ko call karega.

request.description:
Ek hi call me vendor ka **login account + VendorProfile + pehli branch** — teeno bana deta hai.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{adminToken}}` — role `admin`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Onboarding ka **step 1**. Iske bina na branch ban sakti hai na service area.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **Vendor self-signup nahi karta.** Admin yahan account banata hai aur email/password vendor ko deta hai. Vendor `POST /auth/login` se `role: "vendor"` bhej ke login karta hai.
- `email` ya `mobile` — **koi ek** zaroori. Dono de sakte ho.
- `branch` **required** hai — bina branch ke vendor ka koi matlab nahi, aur `coordinates` ke bina delivery distance nahi nikalti.
- Pehli branch apne aap `isDefault: true` ban jati hai aur `profile.defaultLocationId` usi pe set ho jata hai.
- `delivery` na bhejo to platform defaults lag jate hain: `isEnabled: false` (charge ₹0) par baaki values bhari hui — `baseCharge 30`, `perKmRate 5`, `perKgRate 1.5`, `minDeliveryCharge 40`, `baseMaxCharge 150`, `freeDeliveryAbove null`, `maxRadiusKm null`.
- Vendor ban jane ke baad bhi customers ko kuch nahi dikhta — **service area assign karna abhi baaki hai** (step 07/09).
- Response me `vendor` (user), `profile` (VendorProfile) aur `branch` (Location) teeno aate hain. `vendor._id` hi aage ka `vendorId` hai.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| shopName | string | yes | `Nagraj Mart` — 2 se 120 chars |
| password | string | yes | `nagraj@123` — 6 se 64 chars |
| email | string | email ya mobile | `nagraj@gmail.com` |
| mobile | string | email ya mobile | `8210574144` |
| name | string | no | `Nagraj` — owner ka naam |
| legalName | string | no | `Nagraj Traders` — max 150 |
| gstNumber | string | no | `29ABCDE1234F1Z5` — max 20 |
| fssaiNumber | string | no | `11223344556677` — max 20 |
| supportMobile | string | no | Customer support number |
| logo | string | no | Logo ka URL |
| commissionPercent | number | no | `5` — 0 se 100 |
| delivery | object | no | Vendor ki delivery config (na do to defaults) |
| payout | object | no | `accountHolder`, `accountNumber`, `ifsc`, `upiId` |
| branch | object | **yes** | Neeche wali table |

### Enums
| Field | Allowed values | Matlab |
|---|---|---|
| status (response) | `APPROVED` · `SUSPENDED` | Naya vendor `APPROVED` banta hai |
| branch.type (response) | `VENDOR_BRANCH` | Customer address se alag |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | — | Is email/mobile ka vendor pehle se hai |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 403 | — | Admin token nahi hai |

### `branch` object

| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | no | `Main Branch` — branch ka label |
| shopOrBuildingNumber | string | no | `24` |
| address | string | yes | `24, PB Road, Near Jayadeva Circle` |
| area | string | no | `Vidyanagar` |
| city | string | yes | `Davangere` |
| district | string | yes | `Davangere` |
| state | string | yes | `Karnataka` |
| country | string | no | `India` |
| zipcode | string | yes | `577001` |
| formattedAddress | string | no | Google se aaya poora address |
| coordinates | number[2] | yes | `[14.4644, 75.9218]` = **[latitude, longitude]** — galat order me delivery charge galat aayega |
| isDefault | boolean | no | `true` → isse distance naapi jayegi |

### Onboarding ka poora sequence

```
02  POST /vendors/create                      → vendorId + branchId
05  GET  /vendors/:id/branches                (optional — extra branch chahiye to 04)
07  GET  /service-areas/lookup?zipcode=577001 → pincode free hai ya nahi (PEHLE ye)
08  POST /vendors/:id/service-areas           → pincode assign  ✅ ab customers ko dikhega
```

request.description:
Vendor ko ek ya zyada pincode assign karta hai. **Yahi wo step hai jiske baad customers ko vendor ka catalog dikhna shuru hota hai.**

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{adminToken}}` — role `admin`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Onboarding ka aakhri step — branch ban jane ke baad.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- `locationId` **required** hai — batana padta hai kaunsi branch ye area serve karegi. Isliye branch pehle banani padti hai.
- `areas` array bhi chalega aur single object bhi.
- **`409 PINCODE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED`** — ye platform ka sabse important rule hai. Ek pincode do vendors ko nahi de sakte. Response me purane vendor ka `shopName` aata hai, panel me wahi message dikhao: *"577001 pehle se Nagraj Mart ko assign hai."* Transfer karna ho to `PUT /service-areas/reassign`.
- Ye rule DB level pe bhi lagta hai (unique partial index) — race condition me bhi double assign nahi ho sakta.
- Per-area optional overrides: `etaMinutes` (app me 'X min me delivery'), `minOrderAmount`, `freeDeliveryAbove`, `deliveryChargeOverride`.
- Response me `created` count aur banaye gaye `areas[]` aate hain.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| locationId | ObjectId | **yes** | `{{branchId}}` — kaunsi branch serve karegi |
| areas | object[] \| object | **yes** | Neeche wali table |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | `PINCODE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED` | Ye pincode pehle se kisi aur vendor ka hai (response me uska `shopName` aata hai). Transfer karna ho to `PUT /service-areas/reassign` use karo. |
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 404 | — | Vendor ya branch nahi mili |

### `areas[]` ka har item

| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| zipcode | string | **yes** | `577001` |
| city | string | no | `Davangere` |
| district | string | no | `Davangere` |
| state | string | no | `Karnataka` |
| country | string | no | `India` |
| etaMinutes | number | no | `60` — app me delivery time dikhane ke liye |
| minOrderAmount | number | no | `199` — is area ke liye alag minimum |
| freeDeliveryAbove | number | no | `499` — is area me itne upar free |
| deliveryChargeOverride | number | no | Fix charge — vendor ki calculation ko bypass karta hai |

item.name: 13 · 🆕 Pincode doosre vendor ko transfer karo

request.description:
Ek pincode ek vendor se le kar doosre ko de deta hai — atomically, ek hi call me.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{adminToken}}` — role `admin`

**Sequence me kab:**
- **`409 PINCODE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED` ka official fix.**
- Vendor band ho jaye aur uska area doosre ko dena ho.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- Purana area deactivate/delete hota hai aur naya banta hai — beech me pincode kabhi unassigned nahi rehta.
- **⚠️ Asar turant hota hai:** us pincode ke customers ko agli hi request pe naye vendor ka catalog dikhega. Unke cart me purane vendor ke items honge to `409 CART_VENDOR_CONFLICT` milega — app usse handle karti hai.
- Purane vendor ke chal rahe orders waise hi rehte hain — wo unhe deliver karega.
- `toLocationId` naye vendor ki hi branch honi chahiye.

### Request body
| Field | Type | Required | Matlab / sample |
|---|---|---|---|
| zipcode | string | yes | `577001` — jo transfer karna hai |
| toVendorId | ObjectId | yes | Naya vendor |
| toLocationId | ObjectId | yes | Naye vendor ki branch |

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | — | Joi validation fail. `message` me saari galtiyan comma-separated aati hain. |
| 404 | — | Pincode, vendor ya branch nahi mili |

response.name: 200 · OK

request.description:
Vendor se ek pincode hata deta hai (soft delete). Pincode free ho jata hai.

🆕 **NEW** — ye endpoint pehle tha hi nahi

**Auth:** `Bearer {{adminToken}}` — role `admin`

**Sequence me kab:**
- Vendor ne area cover karna band kar diya.

**Zaroori baatein:**
- **⚠️ Hatate hi us pincode ke customers ko `404 PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` milne lagega.** Doosra vendor dena ho to `reassign` behtar hai — usme gap nahi aata.
- Soft delete hai, par unique index sirf `isDeleted: false` pe lagta hai — isliye pincode turant dobara assign ho sakta hai.

### Errors
| HTTP | `code` | Kab aata hai |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | — | Resource nahi mila (ya aapke scope me nahi hai). |
| 401 | — | Token missing / expired / invalid. |

- `totals` = platform level, `vendors[]` = har vendor ka orders/revenue.

| role | `user` · `vendor` · `admin` · `staff` | User ka role |
| sortBy | `createdAt` · `name` · `email` · `lastActivity` | Isse bahar kuch = 422 |

### Errors

|---|---|---|
